overallReasoning.summary: Owner-approved revised resource list: public HTTPS web, internal API, private delegated PostgreSQL, private Blob/Key Vault, Basic broker and existing ABAC Standard registry. Dispatch every15minutes. Reuse existing Foundry and protect unrelated resources.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: Budget-first demonstration, not an HA enterprise deployment or guaranteed USD150 hard cap. Basic Service Bus and existing Standard ACR public authenticated endpoints are explicitly accepted; no Premium upgrades, NAT, Firewall, gateway or private ACA ingress endpoint. Existing Foundry API-key authentication is retained as user-directed, protected by Key Vault; managed identity is used where supported. Referenced resources are never recreated or reconfigured. Only Tactiq image repositories and conditioned additive identity grants are permitted in the shared registry. Existing related-resource IDs live in insights.json and are environment-specific. Cloud composition bounds active database leases to one across tenants; this does not guarantee immediate termination of stale native processes. Independent recovery, per-connection database identity tokens and verified successful model settlement are implemented. Private bootstrap, Linux startup, actual workload/transfer costs and production verification remain release requirements.

plan.validation: Final pilot plan explicitly approved for Bicep generation. JSON, dependency DAG, subnet ranges and cost arithmetic checked. Private endpoint/model rates verified. Dispatcher recovery and database lease admission have targeted and real PostgreSQL coverage; token refresh, bounded model requests and settlement have offline coverage. Generated staged Bicep compiles; source/compiled static scans have no unresolved findings with two explicitly documented storage exceptions. Offline bootstrap/input safeguards are tested. No Linux/Azure deployment, live bootstrap or hard subscription cap is certified; provisioning is NOT approved.
